name: @gameforge/ui-test-harness
description: External unattended controller contracts for the original CodeArts TUI and OpenChamber GUI.

scripts.build:runtime: bun --cwd ../.. run build:foundation && bun --cwd ../.. run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && bun run build
scripts.run:readiness: bun run build:runtime && bun dist/cli.js --headed --tier readiness
scripts.run:acceptance: bun run build:runtime && bun dist/cli.js --headed --tier acceptance
